before: Each obstacle is a hazardous 40 × 40 px block that spawns at a random horizontal position and moves vertically downward at a fixed speed.
after: Each obstacle is a hazardous 40 × 40 px block that spawns at a random horizontal position and moves vertically downward at a fixed speed of 260 px/s.

before: Each obstacle moves vertically downward at a fixed speed of 200 px/s.
after: Each obstacle moves vertically downward at a fixed speed of 260 px/s.

before: The obstacle spawn timer advances continuously. Exactly one obstacle is created whenever the fixed 1-second spawn interval is reached, and each active obstacle moves downward at 200 px/s.
after: The obstacle spawn timer advances continuously. Exactly one obstacle is created whenever the fixed 1-second spawn interval is reached, and each active obstacle moves downward at 260 px/s.
